# Code of conduct

## Our standard

IntentLane contributors and maintainers commit to a respectful, focused, and
welcoming project. Good participation includes:

- discussing the work rather than the person;
- giving reproducible evidence for technical claims;
- respecting privacy, confidentiality, and upstream project boundaries;
- accepting correction when a claim exceeds its evidence;
- helping people participate regardless of experience or background.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory language, sexualized conduct, publishing
private information, and sustained personal attacks are not acceptable.

## Project spaces

This standard applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, review comments,
and public communication made on behalf of the project.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately using the contact path in
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not publish sensitive evidence in an issue.

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close discussions, reject a
contribution, or restrict participation when behavior harms the project or its
participants. Enforcement decisions should name the behavior and apply the same
standard regardless of role.
